snippet.title: Your World Just Got Bigger — SOLVI 1.2
snippet.description:
Two new islands. 56 new discoveries. A whole lot more to explore. 🌍

Your world in SOLVI is growing! Explore the snowy shores of Frostreach and the winding mangrove channels of Verdant Flats in Update 1.2.

Combine elements, uncover new discoveries, and watch your world come to life. With nine islands and 247 discoveries now available, there’s always something new to find.

✨ Explore two new islands
🔥 Experiment with elemental combinations
📖 Track your progress in Your Journey and the Notebook
🧩 Solve optional weekly puzzles
🌱 Build and decorate each island at your own pace

**SOLVI 1.2 is out now on iOS and Android!**

🍎 iPhone & iPad: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/solvi-elemental-world/id6802566275

🤖 Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.virelostudios.solvi


#Solvi #CozyGames #IndieGames
